needsYou.rule.problem.badAmount: Write amounts as numbers, such as 1200 or 1 200,50.
needsYou.rule.problem.rangeBackwards: Write a lowest amount that is no higher than the highest, and a highest amount above zero.
needsYou.done.merged: Merged the duplicate. The app kept the earlier transaction.
needsYou.done.transfer: Marked it as a transfer. The app waits for the other side.
needsYou.done.paired: Paired the two sides of the transfer.
needsYou.done.refund: Marked it as a refund. It reduces what you spent on that job.
needsYou.done.rule: Made a rule for {payee}. {count, plural, one {Sorted # transaction.} other {Sorted # transactions.}}
needsYou.noSuggestion: The app has no suggestion for this one. Press Enter to see what you can do.
needsYou.problem.nothingToRedo: There is nothing to do again.
needsYou.problem.undoBlocked: The app can't undo this, because something has changed these transactions since.
needsYou.problem.redoBlocked: The app can't do this again, because something has changed these transactions since.
needsYou.problem.failed: The app couldn't make this change, and nothing changed.
needsYou.problem.outOfSync: The app saved the change, but this screen couldn't catch up. The app is refreshing the list.
refusal.idTaken: The app can't add this, because something with the same ID already exists.
refusal.accountNumberTaken: The app can't give two accounts the same account number.
refusal.splitDoesNotAddUp: You need the allocations to add up to the whole amount of the transaction.
refusal.nameMissing: You need to give it a name.
refusal.negativeAmount: You can't use a negative amount here.
refusal.amountNotPositive: You need an amount above zero.
refusal.accountNotFound: The app can't find that account.
refusal.groupNotFound: The app can't find that group.
refusal.jobNotFound: The app can't find that job.
refusal.moveNotFound: The app can't find that move at the bank.
refusal.transactionNotFound: The app can't find that transaction.
refusal.currencyFixed: You can't change the currency once the app holds a transaction or a figure you entered. To use another currency, export what you want to keep, delete everything in Settings and set up again.
refusal.planStartFixed: You can't change the plan start once you've opened a month or the app holds a transaction.
refusal.jobKindFixed: You can't change what kind of job this is. You can add a new job instead.
refusal.bufferStaysActive: You can't pause, finish or archive the buffer. You can set its target to zero months instead.
refusal.bufferCannotBeDeleted: You can't delete the buffer. You can set its target to zero months instead.
refusal.bucketHoldsMoney: You can't delete a job while its bucket holds money. Move the money to another job first.
refusal.jobInUse: You can't delete a job that has assignments or transactions. You can archive it instead.
refusal.monthNotNext: You can only open the next month of the plan.
refusal.monthNotOpen: You can only change a month while it's open or reopened.
refusal.monthNotClosed: You can only reopen a month you've closed.
refusal.sameJob: You can't move money from a job to itself.
refusal.moveExceedsAssignment: You can't move more than the job has assigned in the month.
refusal.sameAccount: You need two different accounts for a move at the bank.
refusal.moveNotToDo: You can only mark a move at the bank as done or skipped while it's still to do.
refusal.historyFromPlanStart: The app treats only transactions from before the plan start as history.
refusal.notHistoryBeforePlanStart: The app treats every transaction from before the plan start as history, except income that funds a month from the plan start on.
refusal.breaksFacts: The app can't make this change, because it would leave your data inconsistent.
refusal.proposalNotSuggested: You can only decide on a suggestion that's still waiting for you.
refusal.proposalNotAccepted: The app applies a suggestion only once you accept it.
refusal.proposalStale: Your data changed after the app worked out this suggestion, so the app won't apply it. The app will work it out again.
refusal.importFingerprintLive: The app has already imported this file. To import it again, undo that import first.
refusal.importDisagrees: The app can't import this file, because its rows and transactions don't agree.
refusal.importNotFound: The app can't find that import.
refusal.mergeSameTransaction: You need two different transactions to merge.
refusal.mergeMismatch: The app can only merge two transactions on the same account with the same amount.
refusal.mergeSameFile: The app can't merge these, because one bank file lists them both, so they are two transactions.
refusal.transferSameAccount: You need two transactions in different accounts to make a transfer.
refusal.transferAmountsDiffer: You can only pair two transactions with the same amount going opposite ways.
refusal.transferAlreadyPaired: You've already paired one of these transactions with another.
refusal.moveDoesNotMatch: The app can only mark a move at the bank done with a transfer between the same accounts for the same amount.
refusal.ruleNotFound: The app can't find that rule.
refusal.ruleCounterpartyMissing: You need to say who the rule is for.
refusal.ruleWeightNotPositive: You need each share of a split to have a whole weight above zero.
refusal.ruleRangeBackwards: You need the lowest amount to be no higher than the highest.
refusal.planStartMonthOpened: You can't move the plan start once you've opened a month.
